hook: Pichai has led Google as CEO since October 2015 and Alphabet as CEO since December 2019. Under his leadership Google merged its Brain and DeepMind research teams into Google DeepMind in 2023 and released the Gemini family of AI models the same year.
name: Sundar Pichai

quote.text: I'm excited about Alphabet and its long term focus on tackling big challenges through technology.
quote.context: Sundar Pichai, on becoming CEO of Alphabet, Alphabet Investor Relations, December 3, 2019

primary.name: Alphabet management change, Alphabet Investor Relations, December 3, 2019
Announcing Google DeepMind, Google DeepMind blog, April 20, 2023
Introducing Gemini, our largest and most capable AI model, Google blog, December 6, 2023

timeline.event: Becomes CEO of Google in October 2015 when Alphabet is formed as its parent company
timeline.impact: Takes over operational leadership of Google's core businesses.

timeline.event: Becomes CEO of Alphabet on December 3, 2019
timeline.impact: Succeeds co-founders Larry Page and Sergey Brin, who remain board members and shareholders.

timeline.event: Announces the formation of Google DeepMind on April 20, 2023
timeline.impact: Merges Google Brain and DeepMind into one AI research and product organization.
Launches Google's multimodal model family built by Google DeepMind.

quick_facts: Chief Executive Officer of Alphabet Inc. and of Google LLC
Named CEO of Google on August 10, 2015, effective with Alphabet's formation in October 2015
Named CEO of Alphabet on December 3, 2019, succeeding co-founder Larry Page
Announced the merger of Google Brain and DeepMind into Google DeepMind on April 20, 2023
Announced the Gemini 1.0 model family on December 6, 2023

achievements.title: Google DeepMind formation
achievements.impact: Announced April 20, 2023, consolidating Google's AI research groups into a single unit led by Demis Hassabis.

achievements.title: Gemini model family
achievements.impact: Introduced December 6, 2023, as Google's first natively multimodal foundation model family, built by the combined Google DeepMind team.
